common_limits: No reviewed source establishes the legal owner, current authoritative administrative parent, physical land/water status, ownership, or cause of any component.
Positive overlay area is a geometric comparison result, not evidence of legal containment, ground position, or physical land.
All 48 target component rows and all eight contact features remain part of the scope, including unresolved and no-intersection cases.
Source licensing and attribution fields are claims from preserved metadata; only the explicit service layer licenseInfo field is absent, and no blanket legal reuse conclusion is made.
